summary: Sprint 5 — 4 features verified end-to-end. Backend: 10/10 pytest (1 skipped, non-owner context not available). Frontend: AllLensesModal fires 6 lenses in parallel (24 gestures on Tuli Highlights, modal opens with progress bar + 6 slides with correct testids, skeleton→Loader2→done with Observation/Implication/Action/Question-for-management all rendered, Done button closes). Mobile camera upload: upload-camera-btn + upload-camera-input both present with correct attrs (type=file, accept=image/*, capture=environment). CompositionStrip: visually confirmed on LensRoom detail showing LLM mode=live, Lens applied=Organisational Culture, Signal ref=688c1b5c…, Composed timestamp, By=author; briefing strip testid composition-strip-briefing-{id} confirmed present on /app/briefings. Audit router extraction: /api/contexts/{id}/audit-log (GET) + /api/contexts/{id}/export (POST) both return 200 from /app/backend/routers/audit.py; export payload intact — export_version='3.0' + context + accounts (password_hash filtered) + memberships + invitations + consent_decisions + audit_log + telemetry_events + exported_at all present.

integration_issues.issue: Could not click into a simulation detail during this run to visually verify composition-strip-simulation-{id} (user's sim history rail didn't expose a clickable row with common data-testid patterns — simulate-row-/sim-card-/simulate-history items were not clickable links). Code inspection confirms Simulate.jsx:148 renders <CompositionStrip artefact={sim} kind="simulation" />, so it WILL render once a sim is opened. Recommend adding a data-testid="simulate-history-item-{id}" on each history row to make it reliably clickable by tests.

issues: Radix Dialog console warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for {DialogContent}' — add a visually-hidden DialogDescription for a11y (non-blocking, cosmetic warning only).

action_items: Add DialogDescription (sr-only) inside AllLensesModal DialogContent to silence Radix a11y warning.
Add data-testid="simulate-history-item-{id}" (or similar) on Simulate history rows to enable automated navigation to a simulation detail and verify composition-strip-simulation-{id} live.
Minor: server.py is actually 1255 lines (not 1253 as claimed in PR description) — delta is non-material; extraction itself is correct and both endpoints are identically behaved.
critical_code_review_comments: audit.py (new router) is clean, ~70 lines, uses Depends(require_context_membership()) correctly; owner_only=True guard preserved on /export. _id excluded from all finds. Password_hash, mfa_secret, mfa_secret_pending projected out of accounts in export payload — good.

AllLensesModal.jsx correctly uses Promise.all across catalog to fire 6 parallel lens runs; each slide transitions pending→running→done|error independently; progress strip hides once all complete; modal state resets when closed (started+runs cleared). Clean UX.

AllLensesModal auto-kicks-off via useEffect([open,catalog,started,runAll]) — note that runAll is re-memoized whenever catalog/signal/contextId change, which could in rare cases re-fire if those change while modal is open; guarded by `started` flag so it's safe.
CompositionStrip.jsx is tight (~100 lines), collapsed by default (useState(false)), rows built declaratively by kind; correctly returns null when rows is empty (safe for missing artefact).

Workspace.jsx: cameraInput ref created alongside fileInput; hidden input with capture='environment' feeds into the same onFiles() pipeline — desktop will fall through to file picker, mobile will open camera. Correct.

Highlights.jsx: signal-lens-all-{id} gesture is placed next to 'Act on this' on every signal card — verified 24 gestures on Tuli context, modal opens on click and resolves within ~60-90s for all 6 lenses.

success_rate.backend: 100% (10/10 passed, 1 skipped — no non-owner context on this account to assert 403)
success_rate.frontend: 95% — AllLensesModal + camera + briefing/lens CompositionStrip confirmed; simulation strip code-verified but not visually exercised due to missing clickable history testid

seed_data_creation: One lens.run persisted in Tuli context via AllLensesModal (organisational_culture lens). No destructive ops. Export endpoint writes a 'context.exported' audit entry per invocation (2 entries added by test suite).
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_sprint5.py covers audit router extraction (audit-log + export with full payload shape + password_hash filtering), lens catalog + single lens/run (exercises the same endpoint that AllLensesModal fires 6x in parallel), and basic regressions (signals, briefings, auth/me). Pairs with test_iter6.py for full regression. AllLensesModal on /app/highlights takes 60–90s to complete all 6 slides — use page.wait_for_function with 120s timeout when scripting. For the simulation CompositionStrip, a clickable data-testid on history rows is needed — flagged as action item.
